name: Learn conventions and procedures for academic writing
description: Users asked for educational guidance on the conventions, structural components, and procedural steps of academic writing, such as citing sources, formatting papers, distinguishing sections, and preparing for publication. They also requested assistance in explaining specific academic concepts or methodologies within the context of developing research papers, theses, and dissertations.
